author: Codex
body: Randy observed the cup rolling between two spots and authorized diagnosis only, with no fixes. Original hash-verified simulation samples and live viewer agree. Measured motion spans approximately 1.97 m, reverses about every 50 seconds and reaches 8.8 cm/s. No robot commands or robot contacts occur in the retained three-minute window. One brief cabinet contact affects one reversal; a later 51-second interval has only floor contact yet regains about 0.585 mJ of kinetic energy from near rest while gravitational potential varies by 0.00373 mJ. The frozen cup has contact dimension 3, zero joint damping and no enabled rolling resistance. Missing rolling resistance explains persistence but not repeated reacceleration. Interpretation: a numerical cylinder/floor contact artifact is implicated; exact solver causation remains unproven. Reconstructed forces omit original warmstart/actuator history. No new simulation steps, live intervention, repair or condition comparison occurred. This remains a physics realism concern, not evidence of moving-object grasp capability or a scientific condition result. Randy subsequently requested deferred hibernation and will decide later work.
